message.content: {"A0100":"A0100 most plausibly seeks to deny closure and reduce exposure by extending east in level, increasingly fast flight instead of turning toward B0100, given B0100 remained behind-left while the two opposing missiles nearest its altitude stayed northwest and did not materially close.","A0200":"A0200 most plausibly seeks to spoil an intercept and escape east by combining a sustained descent with repeated high-bank course changes while retaining high speed, given that B01001 approached from behind-left near its altitude and substantially closed; the maneuver had not opened separation by the window’s end."}

answers.A0100: A0100 most plausibly seeks to deny closure and reduce exposure by extending east in level, increasingly fast flight instead of turning toward B0100, given B0100 remained behind-left while the two opposing missiles nearest its altitude stayed northwest and did not materially close.
answers.A0200: A0200 most plausibly seeks to spoil an intercept and escape east by combining a sustained descent with repeated high-bank course changes while retaining high speed, given that B01001 approached from behind-left near its altitude and substantially closed; the maneuver had not opened separation by the window’s end.
